27199ce41c48bd49.title: Pancotase Tablet
27199ce41c48bd49.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for indigestion, loss of appetite (poor appetite), overeating, food stagnation, promotion of digestion, and abdominal bloating caused by indigestion.
27199ce41c48bd49.usage:
Adults take 1 to 2 tablets at a time, 3 times a day after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
27199ce41c48bd49.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: children aged 7 or under, or patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have an allergic constitution, or if you are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or have experienced such a reaction. 6a201750927fe1c9.title: Sokicool Tablet
6a201750927fe1c9.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for gastric hyperacidity, heartburn, stomach discomfort, abdominal bloating, food stagnation, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, sour belching, indigestion, loss of appetite (poor appetite), overeating, promotion of digestion, and abdominal bloating caused by indigestion.
6a201750927fe1c9.usage:
Adults take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times a day after each meal.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
6a201750927fe1c9.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption; children (under 15 years); pregnant women or women who may be pregnant; or breastfeeding women.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have experienced an allergic reaction, have kidney impairment or liver impairment, are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or have experienced an allergic reaction to it, have high blood pressure or are elderly, or have a heart or kidney disorder or edema. If symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

Do not take together with gastrointestinal analgesics or antispasmodics. Consult a pharmacist before taking together with potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, ethacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide).

Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if any of the following occur: allergic symptoms (rash, itching, etc.); rarely palpitations, drowsiness, dizziness, fatigue, headache, constipation, or dry mouth; rapid heartbeat; elevated GOT and GPT; decreased urine volume; swelling of the face, hands, or feet; heavy eyelids; stiff hands; rising blood pressure; headache; weakness; limb cramps; or paralysis.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Gastric hyperacidity, heartburn, stomach discomfort, abdominal bloating, food stagnation, nausea

9762db84f8d2dbae.title: Ventib Tablet
9762db84f8d2dbae.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for nervous system disorders caused by deficiency of vitamins B1 and B6.
9762db84f8d2dbae.usage:
Adults take 1 tablet once a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
9762db84f8d2dbae.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine, or patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine. If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

Do not take together with levodopa.

Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if hives, rash, itching, loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, nausea, vomiting, or loose stools occur. In newborns and infants, severe sedation, low blood pressure, and respiratory disorders (difficulty breathing, apnea) may occur.

e55b1edb8a3d1297.title: Alpha Ursa Soft Capsule
e55b1edb8a3d1297.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for improvement of liver function in chronic liver disease, and for improvement of physical fatigue and general malaise caused by impaired liver function.
e55b1edb8a3d1297.usage:
Adults take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
e55b1edb8a3d1297.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine; severe biliary obstruction; fulminant hepatitis; pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, or breastfeeding women; children; intestinal disease of the large and small intestine such as Crohn's disease; radiolucent calcified gallstones; non-functioning gallbladder; acute cholecystitis; kidney disease; or peptic ulcer (acute gastric or duodenal ulcer).

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have severe pancreatic disease or gallstones.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

While taking this medicine, do not take it together with oral antidiabetic agents (tolbutamide), cholestyramine, colestipol, medicinal charcoal, antacids containing magnesium or aluminum hydroxide, or drugs that increase cholesterol secretion in the liver (e.g., oral contraceptives containing estrogen, lipid-lowering drugs such as clofibrate).

Stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, constipation, heartburn, stomach discomfort, itching, rash, general malaise, dizziness, calcification of gallstones, elevated liver enzyme levels, decreased white blood cells, or interstitial pneumonia (accompanied by fever, cough, difficulty breathing, or abnormal chest X-ray) occur.

4e0d1c310d822a1b.title: Magcal Soft Capsule
4e0d1c310d822a1b.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for supply of vitamin D during pregnancy and breastfeeding, growth periods, and old age, and for poor development of bones and teeth and prevention of rickets.
4e0d1c310d822a1b.usage:
Those aged 12 or older and adults take 1 capsule once a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
4e0d1c310d822a1b.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine or to soybean oil, soybeans, or peanuts; infants under 12 months of age; hypercalcemia (a state of excess calcium in the blood); sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause); kidney disease; kidney stones; or severe renal failure.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are a pregnant woman, a woman who may be pregnant, or a breastfeeding woman; a premature or young infant; a patient with cardiac or circulatory dysfunction, hypoproteinemia, or a lipid metabolism disorder such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis; a patient who requires careful administration of lipid emulsions; a patient for whom particular risk from fat overload is expected; or hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 or have experienced such a reaction.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

Do not take together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist when using together with cardiac glycosides, anti-aldosterone agents, triamterene, or intravenous lipid preparations. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it.

Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, skin rash, red spots, cardiac arrest, or depressed central nervous system function occur.

0d1a6fe94d1d6e9e.title: Hemolbin-Q Plus Capsule
0d1a6fe94d1d6e9e.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for the prevention and treatment of iron-deficiency anemia.
0d1a6fe94d1d6e9e.usage:
Adults take 1 capsule once a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
0d1a6fe94d1d6e9e.caution:
Warning: an overdose in children aged 6 or under can cause fatal iron poisoning, so keep this medicine out of the reach of children.

Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine; infants under 12 months of age; hemochromatosis (a disease in which iron deposits in the liver and pancreas due to abnormal iron metabolism); hemosiderosis (a state of increased iron content (as hemosiderin) in tissues, locally or systemically, without causing tissue damage); non-iron-deficiency anemia (e.g., megaloblastic anemia caused by vitamin B12 deficiency); or patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have a gastrointestinal disease such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional colitis, cardiac or circulatory dysfunction, kidney impairment, or hypoproteinemia, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, if you are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 or have experienced such a reaction, or if you are deficient in folic acid.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

Do not take together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist before taking together with anti-aldosterone agents, triamterene, or 200 mg or more of ascorbic acid (vitamin C). Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea, as well as milk and dairy products, while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it.

Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if any of the following occur: occasionally erythema (red spots), skin disorders, itching, general malaise, allergic symptoms such as bronchial breathing difficulty, hives, photosensitivity of the skin to sunlight, abdominal or stomach pain, stomach cramps, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, coma, nausea, loss of appetite, weight loss, swelling, constipation, black stools, or stomach discomfort.

281182dd947d02e1.title: Kyungnam Vitamin C Tablet
281182dd947d02e1.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for the prevention and treatment of scurvy; for wasting diseases in which the requirement for vitamin C increases, such as lowered physical strength and physical fatigue during pregnancy, breastfeeding, and during or after illness; for capillary bleeding such as gum bleeding, nosebleeds, and blood in the urine; for pigmentation (freckles and dark spots) caused by sunlight or skin conditions; and for cases of presumed vitamin C deficiency such as malabsorption.
281182dd947d02e1.usage:
Adults take 1/2 to 1 tablet (500 to 1,000 mg) once a day or in several divided doses. Take with plenty of water.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
281182dd947d02e1.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine; hyperoxaluria (a state in which excessive oxalate is excreted in the urine); thalassemia; gout; cystinuria; glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency; or oxalate kidney stones.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, a smoker, or a person who chronically consumes alcohol.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Avoid excessive drinking and smoking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are taking oral anticoagulants (coumarin drugs), salicylates, aspirin, iron preparations, phenytoin or certain antiepileptic drugs, oral contraceptives containing estrogen, tetracycline antibiotics, fluphenazine, orlistat, barbiturate derivatives, or corticosteroids.

Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, heartburn, facial flushing, headache, insomnia, kidney stones due to overdose, acidification of the urine, or precipitation of oxalate stones occur.
